chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Abbas ibn ibn Musa from Yunus or another from Hashim ibn al-Muthanna from Sadir said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The private parts of women are forbidden for my ummah.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the private parts of women according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Reported in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on marriage etiquette, this hadith establishes the prohibition of *mahashsh* (typically interpreted as the anus or private parts) for the Muslim community, extending the general Islamic ruling to specific marital contexts. It underscores the sanctity of the female body in Shia jurisprudence, linking physical intimacy to spiritual purity and legal boundaries within the union.
